question: What are the main entities that Plantour operates with?

sections.beforeHtml: The list below is sorted alphabetically by entity name. It includes account-level records, reusable dictionary entities, and trip-specific entities. Entries that start with Trip, Shared, or Itinerary exist inside a selected trip.
items: Account is the user identity and profile in Plantour. It stores personal access information and connects the user to trips, permissions, and subscription state.
Admin is the main owner and organizer of a trip. The admin can create trips, invite people, and assign shared items or shared todos.

AI trip plan is an AI-generated trip draft created from a natural-language request. It can include itinerary parts, activities, and item suggestions so the admin can start from a prepared structure instead of building the whole trip manually.
AI prompt is a saved or reusable request that asks Plantour AI to suggest items from a trip idea or requirement.
Bag is a container, used for holding or carrying items.

Dashboard is the main overview page of Plantour. It serves as a starting point for navigation and can also lead users to public pages such as plan selection. The Dashboard for registered users allows to select a trip and see trip summary data. The Dashboard for public users shows general Plantour information and allows plan selection.
Item is any specific piece of gear, clothing, or personal essential packed to meet a particular need or handle a specific situation during the trip.
Itinerary part is a scheduled trip stop or travel segment in the itinerary. It can include timing, address, notes, and map-related data.
Map is the trip map view where itinerary parts and trip activities are shown together on one map.
Packing list is the list of items packed into a specific trip bag. Plantour can generate and download it as a PDF so it can be printed or used during travel.
Participant is a Traveler included into a trip.
Plan is the subscription level for a Plantour account. It defines billing status and the commercial level of service the user has selected.
Shared expense is a shared trip expense used for group cost tracking.
Shared item is an item intended for shared use by trip participants. It is included in the trip`s shared item list and assigned to a participant for preparation and travel.
Shared todo is a trip related task included into a trip`s shared todo list. It can be assigned to a participant so the admin can track who is responsible for completing it.
Template item is a reusable suggested packing item from Plantour template collections.
Todo is a task or action that needs to be completed.
Traveler is a person invited by the Admin. The person has to be a Traveler to have access to the Admin`s trips as a Participant.
Trip is a journey or excursion to a specific destination. Can be created by the Admin. Cannot be created by the Participant.
Trip activity is an activity planned inside a trip. It can be personal or shared and can include an address for map viewing and directions.
Trip bag is a Bag included into one specific trip.
Trip comment is a message posted in the trip conversation so participants can discuss that trip in one place.
Trip expense is a personal expense tracked inside one specific trip.
Trip item is an Item added to one specific trip. It belongs to that trip`s own item list and can be packed into a trip bag.
Trip note is a rich-text note stored inside a trip. It can include text, formatting, and images.
Trip report is a downloadable summary of a trip and its related trip data. It gives the user a printable snapshot of the trip in one document.
Trip todo is a Todo added to one specific trip.
